description: Source code implementing classes for converting 16-bit plane data to half-floats, including specific implementations using bitwise operations and libyuv library functions.

classes.name: HalfFloatMaker_xor
classes.description: Implements half-float conversion by OR-ing source data with 0x3800 based on bits per channel.

classes.name: HalfFloatMaker_libyuv
classes.description: Uses libyuv to convert 16-bit shorts to half-floats, with optimizations based on bits per channel.

methods.name: Offset
methods.description: Returns the offset value used in conversion, 0.5 for xor implementation, 0.0 for libyuv.

methods.name: Multiplier
methods.description: Returns the multiplier used in conversion, calculated based on bits per channel.

methods.name: MakeHalfFloats
methods.description: Converts source 16-bit data to half-floats, using either bitwise OR or libyuv functions.
